name: Bodyweight Split Squat
cues: Take a long split stance with your back heel up
Drop your back knee straight down toward the floor
Keep your weight over the front foot
Stand up by pushing through the front heel

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: Front knee 14 to 100, rear knee 6 to 95, hands relaxed (close 0.3), feet fixed. But the stance is 0.76 m ball to ball (lunges use 0.90) under a 'long split stance' cue. The front shin leans 28 deg and the knee travels 8 cm past the front ball at the bottom.
